messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary group "canary-1748" p95 latency +45% for route /v1/generate (us-west-2). Auto-rollback threshold exceeded. Suggested action: auto-rollback. Telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/internal/1748 :rotating_light:

maya: seeing this. can someone confirm it's not metric flapping? any dedicated customers pinned to this rollout?

ramiro: checking now. dedicated pools unaffected (ded-eu-2 etc). us-west-2 traffic ~12%. No dedicated customer pins detected. I see a new kernel flag (quant-int4) enabled on canary hosts.

olivia: FYI I toggled the kernel flag off on two canary hosts ~5m ago — latency improved ~10% but still above baseline. partial mitigation.

maya: deploy-bot wants auto-rollback but i prefer manual rollback so we can coordinate release notes & CS/legal if needed. tagging kate + cs-lead for comms. :eyes:

kate: noted. CS: we should only send customer-facing comms if the rollback affects committed dedicated pools or causes visible errors. Draft template ready if we proceed.

cs-lead: ack. i'll pull customer list and prepare notification drafts. target notify window 30m after decision.

ramiro: quick root-cause hypothesis: int4 quant kernel regresses p95 on longer sequences; baseline models unaffected. we can stop the rollout by pinning hosted to previous model:

```
# pin hosted in us-west-2 to last known-good
rctl release pin --service=hosted --model-version=2.1.2 --region=us-west-2
```

olivia: recommend: pin hosted first to stop further rollout, then rollback only the canary group (smaller blast radius). prepare release-note snippet while ops runs commands.

maya: plan: 1) pin hosted -> 2) rollback canary-1748 -> 3) hold release window -> 4) update release notes + postmortem. who will execute pin/rollback?

ramiro: i'll run the pin and rollback. starting now.

deploy-bot: ACTION: rctl release pin --service=hosted --model-version=2.1.2 --region=us-west-2 (initiated by ramiro) :white_check_mark:

ramiro: rollback started: /ops/run-rollback --group canary-1748 --to-version 2.1.2

sre-oncall: observing telemetry. p95 trending back toward baseline since rollback started. i'll keep watch and escalate if it drifts. :thumbsup:

kate: draft release note (short):

```
We identified increased request latency for the /v1/generate endpoint during a canary rollout in us-west-2. We reverted the canary group to model version 2.1.2 to restore performance. Impact: brief elevated p95 for a portion of hosted traffic; no committed dedicated customer pins affected. Customers: no action required. We will follow up with a short postmortem and next steps.
```

maya: thanks. once rollback finishes, update the public release notes page and close the window. if any dedicated customer is impacted, CS will notify and legal will review messaging before send.

cs-lead: we have one customer with a migration scheduled next week (not pinned). we'll continue to monitor and will notify if anything changes.

ramiro: rollback complete for canary-1748. group stable on 2.1.2. telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/internal/1748?view=post-rollback

maya: closing this thread. quick retro tomorrow. thanks all :tada:
